description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll on the Blown Cover Table.

The result is negated entirely and has no effect. You do not reroll; nothing happens.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Overreach" / the Blown Cover Table has zero Foundry-schema footprint. classes.scavenger-spy.json has no SpecialResource for Overreach uses/day (SpecialResource can model a one-way daily pool via renew:false, but none is defined here), and the Blown Cover Table itself is a GM random table with no representation in any card. Nothing to hook: the Blown Cover Table isn't tracked anywhere in Foundry-schema terms.
